proof.label: Sample

reviews.text: Marla asked me to read the gauge over the phone, then told me it was probably the tank, not the pump. She was right. Tank swap, ninety minutes, and I kept a pump that still had years left.
reviews.name: Rosalind T.

reviews.text: Shower went cold-weak-strong every few seconds. They put in a constant pressure setup and now my wife and I can both run water at once. Small thing, big difference.
reviews.name: Harlan B.

reviews.text: Buying a house on six acres near Crawford and the lender wanted a well report. Got flow, pressure, a bacteria test and the age of every part, in a format my agent could actually use.
reviews.name: Yesenia R.

reviews.text: The breaker kept tripping. Another company quoted a new pump. These folks measured the amps, found a burned capacitor in the control box, and charged me for that.
reviews.name: Douglas F.

reviews.text: Our water tasted salty and the kettle was crusted. The test showed exactly why. They recommended a softener sized to the numbers and showed me the math.
reviews.name: Priscilla N.

reviews.text: Woke up to no water before work. The person on the phone had me check two breakers and the switch, then sent someone out. Pump was dead; new one in by mid-afternoon.
reviews.name: Calvin J.

reviews.text: Every reading went on a little card taped inside the well house: pressure, amps, tank charge, date. Next time anything acts up I know where it started.
reviews.name: Bettye S.

proof.guarantee: Flat-rate diagnosis quoted on the phone, and every pump we install is covered for 2 years, parts and labor.
